app.name: wii-LLM
app.coder: based on llama2.c by Andrej Karpathy
app.short_description: Chat with a tiny LLM running on the Wii
app.long_description: wii-LLM runs a small int8 llama2.c language model (TinyStories) on the Wii's CPU. Type English with the on-screen text keyboard (D-pad + A, B = delete, ^ = send). Needs model.bin and tokenizer.bin in the same folder.
